keyPointsEn: RSI and MACD maintain a neutral stance without clear direction, continuing a weak trend, thus lacking distinct buy/sell signals.
The volume ratio of 0.75 is subdued, indicating low confidence in current price movements.
The weekly ADX is at 23.7, in the early stages of trend formation, requiring caution not to confuse with short-term daily adjustments.
analysis.riskNote: ADX 23.7로 추세 미형성 구간에서 거래량 위축이 동반되어, 급격한 변동성 출현 시 추세 전환보다는 되돌림 가능성에 무게를 둔다.
analysis.riskNoteEn: In a non-trending phase with ADX at 23.7 and subdued volume, any sharp volatility is more likely a retracement than a trend reversal.
